methodology: Per councillor per issue per axis: 'for' = their vote aligned with the axis's expansive/permissive outcome, 'against' = aligned with its restrictive outcome (not raw yea/nay — see direction-rules.ts). Recusals and absences are counted separately, never folded into 'against' and never inferred as a position. A councillor with no entry for a motion was not on that meeting's roster (e.g. not a committee member) — not applicable, not absent.
